header.running_head: The Story of The Ansaar During the Battle of Hunayn and the Statement of Rasulullaah ﷺ about them

blocks.text:

When the Ansaar heard this, they exclaimed, "This pleases us." Rasulullaah ﷺ then said, "Respond to what I have said." They said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! You found us in darkness and through you Allaah removed us (from the darkness) taking us into light. You found us on the crumbling edge of Jahannam and through you Allaah saved us. You found us astray and through you Allaah guided us. We are pleased with Allaah as our Rabb, with Islaam as our Deen and with Muhammad ﷺ as our Nabi. O Rasulullaah ﷺ! With an open heart we say that you may do as you please." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "By Allaah! Had you responded by saying something else, I would have said that you have spoken the truth. You could have said (to me), 'Did you not come to us as an outcast and we granted you shelter? Were people not calling you a liar when we believed you? Did we not accept what people were rejecting from you?' You would be true had you said this."
The Ansaar then said, "On the contrary, the favour is from Allaah and from His Rasool ﷺ. It is the favour and grace of Allaah's Rasool ﷺ that is upon us and on others." The Ansaar then started weeping excessively and Rasulullaah ﷺ wept with them. [^1]

Hadhrat Anas bin Maalik (RA) narrates that when Allaah gave the wealth of the Hawaazin tribe as booty to Rasulullaah ﷺ, he started giving as much as a hundred camels to some people. It was then that some people from the Ansaar commented, "May Allaah forgive Rasulullaah ﷺ. He is giving the Quraysh and leaving us out whereas it is our swords that are dripping with blood of the Hawaazin." When Rasulullaah ﷺ was informed about what they said, he called for the Ansaar and gathered them in a leather tent. He did not call anyone besides them. When they had gathered, Rasulullaah ﷺ stood up and said, "What is it that has reached me about you?" Some Ansaar of understanding replied, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Our seniors have said nothing but it was some youngsters who said, 'May Allaah forgive Rasulullaah ﷺ. He is giving the Quraysh and leaving us out whereas it is our swords that are dripping with blood of the Hawaazin'"
Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "I have only given to some people who have newly accepted Islaam to win them over. Does it not please you to know that while other people return home with wealth, you should return home with the Rasool of Allaah ﷺ? I swear by Allaah that what you return with is much better than what they return with." When the Ansaar submitted that they were pleased with this, Rasulullaah ﷺ said to them, "You people will soon find that others will be given great preference over you.
